categories.name: Field Guides
categories.blurb: AcqVault originals — plain-English study guides written for the acquisition workforce. Built for the warrant board and the day-to-day.

items.title: AcqVault Field Guide — Vol. 1
items.subtitle: Contracting Foundations
items.desc: The foundations you actually use day to day — thresholds, methods, and the RFO framing — distilled into a working reference.

items.title: AcqVault Field Guide — Vol. 2
items.subtitle: The Unlimited Warrant Board
items.desc: Board-prep rebuilt around how the panel actually tests: 29 topics each with trigger cues, a step-by-step walkthrough, know-cold facts, pre-answered follow-ups, and messy drill scenarios — plus an unlabeled scenario bank.

categories.name: Templates
categories.blurb: Reusable, fillable documents you can adapt for a contract file. Built as interactive PDFs.

items.title: CASPER MFR
items.subtitle: Contract Acquisition Strategy, Pricing & Execution Review
items.desc: A fillable, multi-phase CASPER review record — with collapsible Phase II/III sections that grow and shrink as needed. Adapt it and drop it in the contract file. Best in Adobe Acrobat (Pro or Standard).

categories.name: Source Documents
categories.blurb: The full text of every indexed source. Most are compiled into one clean PDF per source with an AcqVault watermark and regenerated monthly; the DoD FMR links to the official publisher, and the DoD SSP and R-DFARS PGI are read in-app. Always verify against the official source before relying on a result in a contract file.

items.title: Revolutionary FAR Overhaul
items.subtitle: RFO · Parts 1–53
items.desc: Full text of the RFO, compiled in sequential part order from the live index.

items.title: R-DFARS
items.subtitle: DoD deviations · Parts 201–252
items.desc: The DoD class deviations implementing the FAR overhaul, compiled into one document.

items.title: FAR Companion
items.subtitle: Version 2.0 · FAR Council
items.desc: Practitioner guidance accompanying the overhaul, compiled into one document.

items.title: Category Management Buying Guide
items.subtitle: Beta 0.1 · FAR Council
items.desc: Federal category management buying guidance, compiled into one document.

items.title: DAFI 63-138
items.subtitle: Acquisition of Services · Dept. of the Air Force
items.desc: Department of the Air Force Instruction 63-138, compiled into one document.

items.title: DoD Financial Management Regulation
items.subtitle: DoD 7000.14-R · Volumes 1–16
items.desc: The full DoD Financial Management Regulation — searchable and browsable in-app by volume and chapter. The official combined PDF (all 16 volumes) is hosted by the DoD Comptroller and opens on their site.

items.title: DoD Source Selection Procedures
items.subtitle: USA000740-22-DPC · Aug 20, 2022
items.desc: The Department of Defense Source Selection Procedures — searchable and browsable in-app by section and appendix.

items.title: R-DFARS Procedures, Guidance, and Information
items.subtitle: PGI · the procedural companion to the R-DFARS
items.desc: The PGI attachment that ships with each DoD class deviation — how to build a PIID, what a contract action report must carry, how to run a mentor-protégé agreement. Guidance on executing the rule, not a rule itself.
